title: Theoph: Pharmacokinetics of Theophylline
provenance: R datasets package; Boeckmann, Sheiner and Beal (1994), NONMEM Users Guide Part V; study attributed to Robert Upton.
conversion: Parsed numeric vectors and decoded ordered-factor labels. No observations changed or removed.
limitations: The R dataset does not provide age, height, ideal body weight, smoking status, individual rate constants or a full original study protocol.
